cohort: The study cohort consisted of four additional unrelated patients (age range: 6-22 years) with biallelic variants in CWF19L1, along with patients described in a comprehensive review of the existing literature.
finding: The study expands the understanding of the clinical spectrum and evolution of CWF19L1-related disorder, characterizing it as developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with treatment-resistant seizures and intellectual disability in childhood, followed by progressive ataxia and other extrapyramidal movement disorders in adolescence.
